content: 6 Suka tashi daga Sukkot, suka yi sansani a Etam, a gefen hamada.

title: Ƙidaya 33:7
content: 7 Suka tashi daga Etam, suka koma baya zuwa Fi Hahirot, wajen gabashin Ba’al-Zafon, suka yi sansani kusa da Migdol.

title: Ƙidaya 33:8
content: 8 Suka tashi daga Fi Hahirot, suka ratsa cikin teku zuwa hamada, bayan sun yi tafiya kwana uku a cikin Hamadan Etam, sai suka yi sansani a Mara.

title: Ƙidaya 33:9
content: 9 Suka tashi daga Mara, suka tafi Elim, inda akwai maɓulɓulan ruwa goma sha biyu, da itatuwan dabino guda saba’in, suka yi sansani a can.

title: Ƙidaya 33:10
content: 10 Suka tashi daga Elim, suka yi sansani kusa da Jan Teku.

title: Ƙidaya 33:11
content: 11 Suka tashi daga Jan Teku, suka yi sansani a Hamadan Sin.

title: Ƙidaya 33:12
content: 12 Suka tashi daga Hamadan Sin, suka yi sansani a Dofka.

title: Ƙidaya 33:13
content: 13 Suka tashi daga Dofka, suka yi sansani a Alush.

title: Ƙidaya 33:14
content: 14 Suka tashi daga Alush, suka yi sansani a Refidim, inda babu ruwan da mutane za su sha.

title: Ƙidaya 33:15
content: 15 Suka tashi daga Refidim, suka yi sansani a Hamadan Sinai.

title: Ƙidaya 33:16
content: 16 Suka tashi daga Hamadan Sinai, suka yi sansani a Kibrot Hatta’awa.

title: Ƙidaya 33:17
content: 17 Suka tashi daga Kibrot Hatta’awa, suka yi sansani a Hazerot.

title: Ƙidaya 33:18
content: 18 Suka tashi daga Hazerot, suka yi sansani a Ritma.

title: Ƙidaya 33:19
content: 19 Suka tashi daga Ritma, suka yi sansani a Rimmon Ferez.

title: Ƙidaya 33:20
content: 20 Suka tashi daga Rimmon Ferez, suka yi sansani a Libna.

title: Ƙidaya 33:21
content: 21 Suka tashi daga Libna, suka yi sansani a Rissa.

title: Ƙidaya 33:22
content: 22 Suka tashi daga Rissa, suka yi sansani a Kehelata.

title: Ƙidaya 33:23
content: 23 Suka tashi daga Kehelata, suka yi sansani a Dutsen Shefer.

title: Ƙidaya 33:24
content: 24 Suka tashi daga Dutsen Shefer, suka yi sansani a Harada.

title: Ƙidaya 33:25
content: 25 Suka tashi daga Harada, suka yi sansani a Makhelot.

title: Ƙidaya 33:26
content: 26 Suka tashi daga Makhelot, suka yi sansani a Tahat.

title: Ƙidaya 33:27
content: 27 Suka tashi daga Tahat, suka yi sansani a Tera.

title: Ƙidaya 33:28
content: 28 Suka tashi daga Tera, suka yi sansani a Mitka.

title: Ƙidaya 33:29
content: 29 Suka tashi daga Mitka, suka yi sansani a Hashmona.

title: Ƙidaya 33:30
content: 30 Suka tashi daga Hashmona, suka yi sansani a Moserot.

title: Ƙidaya 33:31
content: 31 Suka tashi daga Moserot, suka yi sansani a Bene Ya’akan.

title: Ƙidaya 33:32
content: 32 Suka tashi daga Bene Ya’akan, suka yi sansani a Hor Haggidgad.

title: Ƙidaya 33:33
content: 33 Suka tashi daga Hor Haggidgad, suka yi sansani a Yotbata.

title: Ƙidaya 33:34
content: 34 Suka tashi daga Yotbata, suka yi sansani a Abrona.

title: Ƙidaya 33:35
content: 35 Suka tashi daga Abrona, suka yi sansani a Eziyon Geber.

title: Ƙidaya 33:36
content: 36 Suka tashi daga Eziyon Geber, suka yi sansani a Kadesh, cikin Hamadan Zin.

title: Ƙidaya 33:37
content: 37 Suka tashi daga Kadesh, suka yi sansani a Dutsen Hor, a iyakar Edom.

title: Ƙidaya 33:38
content: 38 Bisa ga umarni Ubangiji, Haruna firist, ya hau Dutsen Hor, inda ya mutu a rana ta fari ga watan biyar, a shekara ta arba’in, bayan Isra’ilawa suka fito daga Masar.

title: Ƙidaya 33:39
content: 39 Haruna yana da shekara ɗari da ashirin da uku, sa’ad da ya mutu a Dutsen Hor.

title: Ƙidaya 33:40
content: 40 Sarki Arad Bakan’ane, wanda yake zaune a Negeb na Kan’ana, ya ji labari cewa Isra’ilawa suna zuwa.

title: Ƙidaya 33:41
content: 41 Suka tashi daga Dutsen Hor, suka yi sansani a Zalmona.

title: Ƙidaya 33:42
content: 42 Suka tashi daga Zalmona, suka yi sansani a Funon.

title: Ƙidaya 33:43
content: 43 Suka tashi daga Funon, suka yi sansani a Obot.

title: Ƙidaya 33:44
content: 44 Suka tashi daga Obot, suka yi sansani a Iye Abarim, a iyakar Mowab.

title: Ƙidaya 33:45
content: 45 Suka tashi daga Iyim, suka yi sansani a Dibon Gad.

title: Ƙidaya 33:46
content: 46 Suka tashi daga Dibon Gad, suka yi sansani a Almon Dibilatayim.

title: Ƙidaya 33:47
content: 47 Suka tashi daga Almon Dibilatayim, suka yi sansani a duwatsun Abarim, kusa da Nebo.

title: Ƙidaya 33:48
content: 48 Suka tashi daga duwatsun Abarim, suka yi sansani a filayen Mowab kusa da Urdun, ɗaura da Yeriko.

title: Ƙidaya 33:49
content: 49 A can filayen Mowab, suka yi sansani kusa da Urdun ɗaura da Bet-Yeshimot har zuwa Abel-Shittim.

title: Ƙidaya 33:50
content: 50 A filayen Mowab kusa da Urdun ɗaura da Yeriko ne Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,

title: Ƙidaya 33:51
content: 51 “Ka gaya wa Isra’ilawa cewa, ‘Sa’ad da kuka haye Urdun zuwa Kan’ana,

title: Ƙidaya 33:52
content: 52 ku kori dukan mazaunan ƙasar a gabanku. Ku rurrushe sassaƙaƙƙun duwatsu, da siffofinsu na zubi, ku kuma rurrushe dukan masujadansu na kan tudu.

title: Ƙidaya 33:53
content: 53 Ku mallaki ƙasar, ku kuma zauna a ciki, gama na ba ku ƙasar, ku mallake ta.

title: Ƙidaya 33:54
content: 54 Ku rarraba ƙasar ta wurin jefan ƙuri’a, bisa ga kabilanku. Kabilar da take babba, a ba ta babban gādo, ƙarami kabila kuwa, a ba ta ƙaramin gādo. Duk abin da ƙuri’a ta ba su, shi zai zama nasu. Ku rarraba wannan bisa zuriyar kakanninku.

title: Ƙidaya 33:55
content: 55 “ ‘Amma in ba ku kori mazaunan ƙasar ba, waɗanda kuka bari su ci gaba da zama, za su zama muku hakki a idanunku, da kuma ƙayayyuwa a bayanku. Za su ba ku wahala a ƙasar da kuke zama.

title: Ƙidaya 33:56
content: 56 Sa’an nan kuwa zan yi muku abin da na shirya yin musu.’ ”

title: Ƙidaya 34:1
content: 1 Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,

title: Ƙidaya 34:2
content: 2 “Ka umarci Isra’ilawa, ka ce musu, ‘Sa’ad da kuka shiga Kan’ana, ƙasar da aka ba ku gādo za tă kasance da waɗannan iyakoki.

title: Ƙidaya 34:3
content: 3 “ ‘Gefenku na kudu zai haɗa da wani sashin Hamadan Zin ta iyakar Edom. A gabas, iyakarku ta kudu za tă fara daga ƙarshen Tekun Gishiri,

title: Ƙidaya 34:4
content: 4 tă ƙetare Mashigin Kunama a kudu, tă ci gaba zuwa Zin, sa’an nan tă nufi kudu da Kadesh Barneya. Sa’an nan za tă zarce zuwa Hazar Addar, tă nausa zuwa Azmon,

title: Ƙidaya 34:5
content: 5 inda za tă juya tă haɗu da Rafin Masar, tă kuma ƙarasa a Bahar Rum.

title: Ƙidaya 34:6
content: 6 “ ‘Iyakarku a yammanci, za tă kasance bakin Bahar Rum. Wannan ce za tă zama iyakarku a yamma.

title: Ƙidaya 34:7
content: 7 “ ‘Iyakarku a arewanci kuwa za tă tashi daga Bahar Rum zuwa Dutsen Hor,

title: Ƙidaya 34:8
content: 8 za tă kuma tashi daga Dutsen Hor, zuwa Lebo Hamat. Sa’an nan tă miƙe zuwa Zedad,

title: Ƙidaya 34:9
content: 9 tă ci gaba zuwa Zifron, sa’an nan tă ƙarasa a Hazar-Enan. Wannan ce za tă zama iyakarku a arewa.

title: Ƙidaya 34:10
content: 10 “ ‘Iyakarku a gabashi, za tă tashi daga Hazar-Enan zuwa Shefam.

title: Ƙidaya 34:11
content: 11 Iyakar za tă gangara daga Shefam zuwa Ribla a gefen gabashin Ayin, sa’an nan tă ci gaba a gangaren gabashin Tekun Kinneret.

title: Ƙidaya 34:12
content: 12 Sa’an nan tă gangara ta Urdun, tă ƙarasa a Tekun Gishiri. “ ‘Wannan za tă zama ƙasarku, tare da iyakokinta a kowane gefe.’ ”

title: Ƙidaya 34:13
content: 13 Sai Musa ya umarci Isra’ilawa ya ce, “Ku raba wannan ƙasa da za ku gāda ta hanyar jefa ƙuri’a. Ubangiji ya umarta cewa a ba da ita ga kabilu tara da rabi,

title: Ƙidaya 34:14
content: 14 saboda iyalan kabilar Ruben, kabilar Gad da rabin kabilar Manasse sun riga sun sami gādonsu.

title: Ƙidaya 34:15
content: 15 Waɗannan kabilu biyu da rabi, sun sami gādonsu a wancan hayin Urdun a gabashin Yeriko wajen fitowar rana.”

title: Ƙidaya 34:16
content: 16 Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,

title: Ƙidaya 34:17
content: 17 “Waɗannan su ne sunayen mutanen da za su raba muku ƙasar gādo. Eleyazar firist, da Yoshuwa ɗan Nun.

title: Ƙidaya 34:18
content: 18 Ka kuma naɗa shugaba guda ɗaya daga kowace kabila domin yă taimaka a rabon ƙasar.

title: Ƙidaya 34:19
content: 19 “Ga sunayensu. “Kaleb ɗan Yefunne, daga kabilar Yahuda;

title: Ƙidaya 34:20
content: 20 Shemuyel ɗan Ammihud, daga kabilar Simeyon

title: Ƙidaya 34:21
content: 21 Elidad ɗan Kislon, daga kabilar Benyamin;

title: Ƙidaya 34:22
content: 22 Bukki ɗan Yogli, shugaba daga kabilar Dan;

title: Ƙidaya 34:23
content: 23 Hanniyel ɗan Efod, shugaba daga kabilar Manasse ɗan Yusuf;

title: Ƙidaya 34:24
content: 24 Kemuwel ɗan Shiftan, shugaba daga kabilar Efraim ɗan Yusuf;

title: Ƙidaya 34:25
content: 25 Elizafan ɗan Farnak, shugaba daga kabilar Zebulun;

title: Ƙidaya 34:26
content: 26 Faltiyel ɗan Azzan, shugaba daga kabilar Issakar;

title: Ƙidaya 34:27
content: 27 Ahihud ɗan Shelomi, shugaba daga kabilar Asher;

title: Ƙidaya 34:28
content: 28 Fedahel ɗan Ammihud, shugaba daga kabilar Naftali.”

title: Ƙidaya 34:29
content: 29 Waɗannan su ne mutanen da Ubangiji ya umarta su raba gādo ga Isra’ilawa a ƙasar Kan’ana.

title: Ƙidaya 35:1
content: 1 A filayen Mowab, wajen Urdun, ɗaura da Yeriko, Ubangiji ya yi magana da Musa ya ce,

title: Ƙidaya 35:2
content: 2 “Ka umarci Isra’ilawa su ba wa Lawiyawa garuruwan da za su zauna a ciki daga cikin gādon da Isra’ilawa za su mallaka. A kuma ba su wurin kiwo kewaye da garuruwan.

title: Ƙidaya 35:3
content: 3 Sa’an nan za su kasance da garuruwan da za su zauna, su sami fili, da kuma za su yi kiwon garkensu na shanu da tumaki da kuma sauran dabbobinsu.

title: Ƙidaya 35:4
content: 4 “Wuraren kiwo a kewayen garuruwan da za a ba wa Lawiyawa, girmansu zai zama mai fāɗin kamu dubu ɗaya daga katangar garin.

title: Ƙidaya 35:5
content: 5 A bayan garin, ka auna kamu dubu biyu a wajen gabas, kamu dubu biyu a wajen yamma, kamu dubu biyu wajen kudu, da kuma kamu dubu uku wajen arewa, a bar garin a tsakiya. Za su kasance da wannan a matsayin wurin kiwo na garuruwan.

title: Ƙidaya 35:6
content: 6 “A cikin biranen da za a ba Lawiyawa, shida daga cikin garuruwan za su zama biranen mafaka, inda wanda ya kashe mutum zai gudu yă je. Ban da wannan, a ba su waɗansu garuruwa arba’in da biyu.

title: Ƙidaya 35:7
content: 7 Duka-duka dai a ba Lawiyawa garuruwa arba’in da takwas, tare da wuraren kiwonsu.

title: Ƙidaya 35:8
content: 8 Garuruwan da za ku ba wa Lawiyawa daga ƙasar da Isra’ilawa suka mallaka, za a ba da su bisa girman gādon kowace kabila. Ka karɓi garuruwa masu yawa daga kabilar da take da garuruwa masu yawa, amma kaɗan daga kabilar da ba ta da garuruwa masu yawa.”

title: Ƙidaya 35:9
content: 9 Sa’an nan Ubangiji ya ce wa Musa,

title: Ƙidaya 35:10
content: 10 “Ka yi magana da Isra’ilawa, ka ce musu, ‘Sa’ad da kuka haye Urdun zuwa Kan’ana,

title: Ƙidaya 35:11
content: 11 ku zaɓi waɗansu garuruwan da za su zama biranen mafakarku, inda wanda ya kashe mutum cikin kuskure zai iya gudu zuwa.

title: Ƙidaya 35:12
content: 12 Za su zama wuraren mafaka daga hannun mai bin hakki, don kada a kashe mai kisankai, tun ba a kai shi gaban shari’a, a gaban taron jama’a ba.

title: Ƙidaya 35:13
content: 13 Waɗannan garuruwa shida da aka bayar za su zama biranen mafakarku.

title: Ƙidaya 35:14
content: 14 A ba da uku a wannan gefe na Urdun, a kuma ba da uku a Kan’ana, su zama biranen mafaka.

title: Ƙidaya 35:15
content: 15 Waɗannan garuruwa shida za su zama wurin mafaka wa Isra’ilawa, baƙi da duk sauran mutanen da suke zama a cikinsu, saboda duk wanda ya kashe mutum cikin kuskure yă iya gudu zuwa.

title: Ƙidaya 35:16
content: 16 “ ‘In wani ya bugi wani da makami na ƙarfe har ya mutu, to, shi mai kisankai ne; sai a kashe mai kisankan nan.

title: Ƙidaya 35:17
content: 17 Ko kuwa in wani yana riƙe da dutsen da ya isa yă kashe mutum a hannunsa, ya kuma harbi wani da dutsen har ya mutu, to, shi mai kisankai ne, sai a kashe mai kisankan nan.

title: Ƙidaya 35:18
content: 18 Ko kuwa wani yana da makami na itace a hannunsa da ya isa yă kashe mutum, ya kuma bugi wani da shi har ya mutu, shi ma mai kisankai ne, sai a kashe mai kisankan nan.

title: Ƙidaya 35:19
content: 19 Sai mai bin hakkin jinin yă kashe mai kisankan, sa’ad da ya sadu da mai kisankan, sai yă kashe shi.

title: Ƙidaya 35:20
content: 20 In saboda ƙiyayya, mutum ya laɓe, ya soke wani, ko ya jefe shi da wani abu da gangan har ya mutu,

title: Ƙidaya 35:21
content: 21 ko kuwa saboda ƙiyayya ya naushe shi har ya mutu, sai a kashe wannan mutumin da ya yi haka; shi mai kisankai ne. Sai mai bin hakkin jini yă kashe mai kisankan in ya same shi.

title: Ƙidaya 35:22
content: 22 “ ‘Amma in cikin tsautsayi ne ya soke shi, ba don ƙiyayya ba, ko kuma ya jefe shi, ba da gangan ba,

title: Ƙidaya 35:23
content: 23 ko kuwa bai gan shi ba, ya jefa dutsen da zai kashe shi a kansa, ya kuwa mutu, to, da yake shi ba abokin gābansa ba ne, bai kuma yi nufi yă ji masa ba,

title: Ƙidaya 35:24
content: 24 dole taro su yi hukunci tsakanin mai laifin, da mai bin hakkin jini bisa waɗannan ƙa’idodi.

title: Ƙidaya 35:25
content: 25 Dole taro su kāre wanda ake zargi da kisa, daga mai bin hakkin jini. Su mai da shi birnin mafaka inda ya gudu ya tafi. Dole yă kasance a can sai mutuwar babban firist, wanda aka shafe da mai mai tsarki.

title: Ƙidaya 35:26
content: 26 “ ‘Amma in wanda ake zargin ya kuskura ya fita, ya kai iyakar birnin mafaka wadda ya gudu ya je,

title: Ƙidaya 35:27
content: 27 idan mai bin hakkin jinin ya same shi a bayan gari, mai bin hakkin jinin zai iya kashe mai kisankai ɗin ba tare da wani laifi ba.

title: Ƙidaya 35:28
content: 28 Dole wanda ake zargin, yă kasance a birninsa na mafaka sai bayan mutuwa babban firist; sai bayan mutuwar babban firist ne kawai zai iya komo ga mallakarsa.

title: Ƙidaya 35:29
content: 29 “ ‘Waɗannan su ne za su zama ƙa’idodin da za ku kasance da su, a dukan tsararraki masu zuwa.

title: Ƙidaya 35:30
content: 30 “ ‘Kowa da ya kashe wani, za a kashe shi a matsayin mai kisankai, bisa ga shaidar shaidu. Amma kada a kashe wani bisa ga shaidar mutum ɗaya.

title: Ƙidaya 35:31
content: 31 “ ‘Kada a karɓi fansa don ran wanda ya yi kisankai, wanda ya cancanci mutuwa. Lalle ne a kashe shi.

title: Ƙidaya 35:32
content: 32 “ ‘Kada a karɓi fansa saboda wanda ya tsere zuwa birnin mafaka don yă koma yă zauna gidansa tun babban firist bai rasu ba.

title: Ƙidaya 35:33
content: 33 “ ‘Kada ku ƙazantar da ƙasar da kuke zama a ciki. Zub da jini yakan ƙazantar da ƙasa, ba a kuma iya yin kafara saboda wannan ƙasa da aka zub da jini, sai dai ta wurin jinin mutumin da ya zub da jinin.

title: Ƙidaya 35:34
content: 34 Kada ku ƙazantar da ƙasar da kuke zama, wadda ni kuma nake zama a ciki, gama Ni Ubangiji, ina zama a cikin Isra’ilawa.’ ”

title: Ƙidaya 36:1
content: 1 Sai shugabannin gidajen iyalan Gileyad ɗan Makir, ɗan Manasse, waɗanda suka fito daga kabilar zuriyar Yusuf, suka zo, suka yi magana a gaban Musa da shugabanni, shugabannin iyalan Isra’ilawa.

title: Ƙidaya 36:2
content: 2 Suka ce, “Sa’ad da Ubangiji ya umarce ranka yă daɗe, yă raba ƙasar gādo ga Isra’ilawa ta wurin ƙuri’a, ya umarce ka, ka ba wa ’ya’ya matan nan na Zelofehad ɗan’uwanmu gādonsa.

title: Ƙidaya 36:3
content: 3 To, a ce sun auri mutane daga waɗansu kabilan Isra’ilawa fa; ka ga, za a ɗebe gādonsu daga gādon kakanninmu a ƙara wa gādon kabilan mutanen da suka aura ke nan. Ta haka za a ɗebe sashe daga gādon da aka ba mu ke nan.

title: Ƙidaya 36:4
content: 4 Sa’ad da Shekara ta Murnar Isra’ilawa ta kewayo, za a haɗa gādonsu da na kabilan mutanen da suka aura, a kuma ba su mallakar gādon da aka ɗebe daga kabilar kakanninmu.”

title: Ƙidaya 36:5
content: 5 Ta wurin umarnin Ubangiji, Musa ya ba Isra’ilawa wannan umarni, “Abin da kabilar zuriyar Yusuf suke faɗi, daidai ne.

title: Ƙidaya 36:6
content: 6 Ga abin da Ubangiji ya umarta saboda ’ya’ya matan nan na Zelofehad. Za su iya auri duk wanda suka ga dama, muddin sun yi aure a cikin kabilar kakanninsu.

title: Ƙidaya 36:7
content: 7 Ba gādon Isra’ilan da za a ba wa wata kabila daga wata kabila, gama kowane mutumin Isra’ila zai riƙe gādonsa na kabilar da ya gāda daga kakanninsa.

title: Ƙidaya 36:8
content: 8 Kowace ’ya wadda ta ci gādon ƙasa, a kowace kabilar Isra’ilawa, dole tă auri wani cikin kabilar kakanninta, saboda kowane mutumin Isra’ila yă mallaki gādon kakanninsa.

title: Ƙidaya 36:9
content: 9 Ba gādon da za a ba wa wata kabila daga wata kabila, gama kowace kabilar Isra’ilawa za tă riƙe mallaka da ta gāda.”

title: Ƙidaya 36:10
content: 10 Saboda haka ’ya’yan Zelofehad mata suka yi yadda Ubangiji ya umarci Musa.

title: Ƙidaya 36:11
content: 11 ’Ya’yan Zelofehad mata, Mala, Tirza, Hogla, Milka da Nowa, suka auri ’ya’yan ’yan’uwa na gefen mahaifinsu.

title: Ƙidaya 36:12
content: 12 Suka yi aure cikin kabilar zuriyar Manasse ɗan Yusuf, gādonsu kuwa ya kasance a cikin iyali da kuma kabilar mahaifinsu.

title: Ƙidaya 36:13
content: 13 Waɗannan su ne umarnai da ƙa’idodin da Ubangiji ya ba wa Isra’ilawa ta wurin Musa, a filayen Mowab kusa da Urdun, ɗaura da Yeriko.
